original.statement: NodePool's spec.disruption.consolidationPolicy value `WhenUnderutilized` is renamed to `WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized`.

decision.reason: The upgrade guide says the NodePool ConsolidationPolicy value `WhenUnderutilized` is renamed to `WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized` [ev-80331c11381f]. That is a rename of an allowed value, not of a field. The crd-schema validator confirms that karpenter.sh NodePool spec.disruption.consolidationPolicy exists in both releases [ev-09bbe26d2f4a][ev-760ae3491f13], so the subject is spelled right. The validator also says the old value is allowed in a different API version than the new one. That leaves value-changed, with the old and new values as before and after, the closest fit in the change vocabulary. It is not an exact fit, so my confidence is low.
